text:
Maya (CS): FYI were seeing a delayed webhook delivery affecting ~18 tenants stuck during VPC onboarding (callbacks not processed). Customers report long pending status and some hitting onboarding timeouts. Need a short external update + remediation steps and a high-touch plan for renewal-risk tenants.
Tom (Eng): Root cause: a deploy to the onboarding worker created a slow consumer loop that caused our webhook queue to back up; messages retried but hit client timeouts. Were throttling the worker and draining the queue; ETA for full drain ~3-4h. No data exfiltration.
Maya (CS): can we offer a tenant-level manual replay so CSMs can force a retry now?
Tom (Eng): yes, we added a replay button in the admin console; can replay single tenant webhooks immediately. Automations will also run after drain.
Noor (AE): For renewal-risk customers we should proactively book a troubleshooting call and offer credit for affected onboarding window. Suggest wording: apology, short cause, how were fixing, how to get immediate help, and compensation note.
Karin (Localization): I can prep FR/DE/ES variants but need the final EN copy. ETA 30m.
Jun (Privacy): please include explicit "no credentials accessed" line for compliance.
Maya (CS): Maya to draft two templates: (1) general outbound to impacted, (2) high-touch for renewal-risk with scheduling CTA + credit offer. Keep under 4 short paragraphs.
Maya (CS): Draft 1 (General):

Hi <Customer>,

Were sorry  you may see your onboarding appear stuck. A background issue with webhook processing after a recent deploy prevented some onboarding callbacks from completing. Our engineers have throttled the worker and are draining the queue; most replays will complete automatically within 33hours.

Immediate options: 1) In the onboarding console go to Connections > click "Replay webhook" for your tenant; 2) If you prefer, reply to this email and our team will replay it for you within 1 hour.

Security note: no credentials or customer data were accessed or exposed.

Were applying a one-time credit for the impacted onboarding window. For status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419990000

Redwood Inference Support

Tom (Eng): add exact ETA we gave ops: queue drain expected by +4h, automated retries start immediately after individual replays succeed.
Maya (CS): added. Draft 2 (High-touch):

Hi <Customer>,

Were sorry  your tenants onboarding is delayed due to a webhook processing backlog after a deploy. Weve prioritized your tenant for immediate manual replay and will follow up with a live troubleshooting session to ensure onboarding completes. Your CSM will reach out in the next 30 minutes to schedule.

Compensation: were issuing a credit equal to one day of onboarding service; if this impacts your renewal decision please escalate to your AE and well review additional remediation.

Security note: no credentials accessed. For status updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419990000

Redwood Inference Support

Karin (Localization): will translate once you lock final text. send subject + preheader pls.
Maya (CS): subject: "Onboarding update: webhook delay & next steps" preheader: "Immediate replay available; live help for priority accounts"
Tom (Eng): incident update: queue drain started at 2419990600, throttles in place.
status-bot: Incident 2419990000 status: mitigation in progress  updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419990000
Noor (AE): Ill flag renewal-risk tenants and start scheduling 1:1s. Maya, send me the high-touch list so I can prioritize.
Maya (CS): posting segmented send plan: - EU customers -> local language (Karin), - APAC -> EN/JA, - Priority accounts -> high-touch variant + AE outreach.
Maya (CS): final checklist before send: 1) legal/Jun privacy line included, 2) translations ready, 3) subject + preheader set, 4) replay button live, 5) tracking spreadsheet created. thumbs up to send? :thumbsup:
Karin (Localization): :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): :thumbsup:
Noor (AE): :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): sending now. will update #customer-success after outbound and attach list of priority accounts."
